title: Restructure repository layout to support skills and future prompt artifacts
body:
This updates the repo from a skills-only root layout to an artifact-oriented structure so Claude command files and Pi prompt files can live alongside skills without path conflicts. Existing skill content remains intact, but now sits under a dedicated `skills/` namespace.

- **Repository layout**
  - Move all existing skill bundles from the repo root into `skills/`
  - Add reserved top-level directories for future non-skill assets:
    - `claude-commands/`
    - `pi-prompts/`

- **Installer updates**
  - Update `install-skills.sh` to fetch skill content from `skills/<skill>/SKILL.md`
  - Add `AGENTIC_SKILLS_SOURCE_DIR` so the source subtree is explicit and configurable

- **Documentation**
  - Rewrite README links and installation examples to point at `skills/...`
  - Document the new top-level layout and intended separation between artifact types

- **Resulting structure**
  ```text
  skills/<skill>/SKILL.md
  claude-commands/
  pi-prompts/
  install-skills.sh
  ```
